dimensions.assessment: Directly involves BLM personnel, assigned cross-office employees, and applicants for geothermal authorizations.
dimensions.evidence: appoint from within the Bureau of Land Management a Geothermal Ombudsman... applicants for geothermal authorizations

dimensions.assessment: Aims to improve permitting timelines and dispute resolution, offering retention bonuses up to 25 percent for select federal employees.
dimensions.evidence: may not exceed 25 percent of such rate of basic pay

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes retention allowances for federal personnel subject to available appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: Subject to the availability of appropriations, the Geothermal Ombudsman may pay a retention allowance

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a new Geothermal Ombudsman, a Geothermal Permitting Task Force, cross-office assignments, and annual reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: appoint a Geothermal Ombudsman and establish a Geothermal Permitting Task Force from within the Bureau of Land Management

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent administrative structures within the BLM with ongoing annual reporting.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources... an annual report
